summary: Approved sequence sheets for IS-3 tablets (WA/2018/082) for Istravune Biosciences: twenty-four-month ICH stability pulls, method validation summary and the shelf-life review. The long-term trend supported Istravune's proposed shelf life, and the method remained suitable through the final pull. Project and LIMS numbers remain local.

properties.title: IS3 pulls and suitability results Rev03

sheets.name: Summary

rows.v: Westravelle Analytical Ltd, a Tarnovell company
Istravune IS-3 tablets: twenty-four-month ICH programme

rows: Twenty-four-month ICH stability of IS-3 tablets, with the HPLC assay and related-substances method qualified before the first pull. Pulls to 24 months; interim review completed 30 Apr 2019.

Assay at time zero was {{PRJ0091:stability.t0_assay}} % label claim. The long-term trend supports the proposed shelf life. The method remained suitable through the final pull. Conclusions are limited to the tested interval.

sheets.name: Pulls
rows: Assay as % label claim (HPLC). Impurities as % area. Water by Karl Fischer. Pulls from the ICH chamber programme as recorded on the batch card.

sheets.name: Method

rows.v: Method validation summary: assay and related substances

rows: Validated before the first stability pull under the assay and related-substances validation protocol. Acceptance criteria as written in the protocol.

sheets.name: Review
rows: Long-term data at 25 °C/60% RH support the proposed shelf life to the final pull. Accelerated data follow the same trend and do not change the conclusion.
The final pull was assayed against the same system suitability criteria as the first pull. The method was not changed over the programme.

comments.text: Istravune QA to be sent the signed copy with the shelf-life justification.
